Renamed Chatbot from Duke to Steph
Added greeting and exit messages to chatbot

Steph.java: add ability to store text and display it back
Add mark/unmark commands with Task-based tracking
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the raw String task list with a Task class so each task
tracks its own description and done state, enabling mark/unmark.

Dispatch commands via a switch on the first word instead of
if/else "contains" checks.

Validate the task number before indexing into the list
(parseTaskIndex), so an out-of-range, non-numeric, or missing
argument prints a message instead of crashing.

Extract printWrapped/handleList/handleMark/handleAdd helpers to
remove the duplicated LINE-wrapping and mark/unmark logic that
is repeated across branches.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ToDo, Deadline, and Event task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce ToDo, Deadline, and Event as Task subclasses, each with
its own toString() format, and dispatch todo/deadline/event commands to handlers
that parse the command argument into the fields each type needs.

Deadline and Event arguments are split on their /by, /from,
and /to markers via indexOf rather than String.split(), since
that makes it straightforward to detect a missing marker (index
-1) and reject the command with a usage message instead of
constructing a task with a blank date/time. The default switch
case, which previously added any unrecognized command as a plain
Task, is replaced by the same style of usage-error message.
